metadata.description: Development toolkit for Claude Code — themed plugins (skills, agents, commands, hooks) for multiple web platforms: Shopware 6.7 (comprehensive) and Contao 5.x, more to come.

plugins.name: contao
plugins.description: Contao 5 knowledge library: development (DCA, Models, content elements, fragment controllers, all hooks, Twig, backend modules) and the complete German end-user manual — 8 domain skills over 128 reference files.

plugins.name: discord
plugins.description: Source of truth for the Discord developer platform: the HTTP API, Gateway, interactions and components, OAuth2 and permissions, Activities, the Social SDK, monetization, RPC and voice, distilled from all 159 pages of docs.discord.com.

plugins.name: flatpickr
plugins.description: flatpickr date picker: every option, method, event and format token, plus the official plugins, all 67 locales, themes and mobile behaviour — 2 domain skills.

plugins.name: gotenberg
plugins.description: Gotenberg PDF service: HTML, URL, Markdown and Office conversion, screenshots, the full PDF manipulation set (merge, split, PDF/A, Factur-X, watermark), plus installation, configuration and clients — 3 domain skills.

plugins.name: octo-api
plugins.description: Source of truth for the OCTO tourism ticketing API: all 65 operations, 139 schemas and 254 capability fields, generated from the Ventrata OpenAPI specification and machine-verified.

plugins.name: panther
plugins.description: Symfony Panther browser testing: PantherTestCase, client and crawler API, interactions and waitFor mechanics, screenshots, plus WebDriver installation, PANTHER_* configuration, Selenium and CI — 2 domain skills.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright end-to-end testing: writing tests (locators, actions, assertions, auth), the test runner (config, fixtures, sharding, reporters), the complete library API, trace-based debugging, MCP and CLI tooling — 5 domain skills.

plugins.name: reui
plugins.description: ReUI registry for shadcn projects: the 22 free primitives with their full React API for both Base UI and Radix UI, all 1,105 free c-* examples and 533 premium blocks with an explicit free/Pro/Ultimate split, plus installation, licence setup, the extended theme tokens, RTL and the hosted MCP server across 15 clients. The MCP stays the live source; these references are the fallback when it is rate-limited, signed out or unreachable.

plugins.name: shadcn
plugins.description: shadcn/ui component library: all 59 components with full React source, props and examples for both Radix UI and Base UI, plus setup, theming, forms, blocks, 70 charts and custom registries — 8 domain skills over 444 reference files.

plugins.name: shadcn-vue
plugins.description: shadcn-vue component library: all 64 components with full Vue source, props, slots and demos, plus setup, theming, forms, blocks, charts and custom registries — 8 domain skills over 402 reference files.

plugins.name: shopware-admin
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 Administration: Vue 3 components and modules, routing, repositoryFactory data handling, Pinia stores, ACL, the Vite build, and the Meteor design system with the Admin SDK — 4 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-api
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 APIs: Admin API (OAuth, CRUD, Criteria search, Sync), Store API (access key and context token), plus shared headers, errors, versioning and partial loading — 3 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-apps
plugins.description: Shopware 6 app system: the complete manifest.xml reference, registration and signatures, in-app purchases, plus the app-php-sdk and app-sdk-js — 2 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-checkout
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 checkout: the cart pipeline (collectors, processors, validators, prices, line items), payment handlers and app payment, deliveries and the order state machine, documents — 4 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-cms
plugins.description: Shopware 6 CMS extension: custom Shopping Experience blocks with slot configuration, and custom elements with their administration component, storefront template and data resolver — 2 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-commercial
plugins.description: Shopware Commercial extensions for developers: B2B Suite and Components, Sales Agent, Digital Sales Rooms, Subscriptions, Advanced Search, Nexus, Migration Assistant — 4 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-concepts
plugins.description: Shopware 6 concepts: why the platform is built as it is — architecture, DAL, data stores, extension mechanisms, APIs, app system, messaging, and how each business domain is modelled — 2 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-core
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 plugin fundamentals: plugin base and lifecycle, dependency injection, service decoration and tags, event subscribers with the full event catalogue, CLI commands, system config, logging — 3 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-data
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 Data Abstraction Layer: entities and definitions, all field types and flags, the four association kinds, Criteria queries, aggregations, write events and migrations, plus the 312-entity core reference — 4 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-devops
plugins.description: Shopware 6 operations: shopware-cli, self-hosting (webserver, database, search, caching, workers, deployment), Shopware PaaS, development tooling and troubleshooting — 5 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-framework
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 framework: Store and Admin API extension, Flow Builder, custom rules, scheduled tasks, the message queue, mail templates, media and Elasticsearch — 4 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-frontends
plugins.description: Shopware Frontends (headless): api-client and api-gen types, composables, session context, Nuxt setup, CMS rendering, i18n, B2B and deployment — 3 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-merchant
plugins.description: Shopware 6 merchant knowledge: operating the administration across catalogue, orders, customers, content, marketing, settings, sales channels, Commercial features, Services, Cloud, updates and migration — 16 domain skills with 269 reference files and 292 screenshots.

plugins.name: shopware-migration
plugins.description: Shopware plugin upgrades: the 6.6 to 6.7 to 6.8 path, release notes, deprecation handling, PHP migration patterns, and the three administration migrations (Meteor, Vite, Pinia) — 2 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-quality
plugins.description: Shopware code quality: the platform's coding guidelines, domain exceptions, extendability rules and ADRs, plus PHPStan, ECS, Deptrac and Rector configuration — 3 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-storefront
plugins.description: Shopware 6.7 Storefront: controllers, Pages and PageLoaders, Twig templates and extensions, JavaScript plugins with their event catalogue, themes and SCSS, listing filters, SEO and caching — 5 domain skills.

plugins.name: shopware-testing
plugins.description: Shopware 6 testing across all levels: PHPUnit (unit, integration, Store and Admin API) with fixtures, builders and mocks, Jest for administration and storefront, and Playwright end-to-end — 3 domain skills.

plugins.name: swiper
plugins.description: Swiper touch slider: the complete core API (parameters, methods, properties, events), every module, advanced features and the React, Vue, Angular, Svelte and Solid bindings — 4 domain skills.

plugins.name: zomboid
plugins.description: Source of truth for Project Zomboid build 42 modding: all 3,965 Java classes and 72,831 members, the 1,395 game Lua files, every item and script property, events, world model, server and RCON.

plugins.name: zone-claude-forge
plugins.description: Authoring instrument for this marketplace: writes compliant skills, agents, commands and hooks, distils upstream sources into reference files, and audits existing plugins.
